title: About
heading: Join Hands, Change the World
description: Charitize is an independent non-profit initiative dedicated to uplifting underprivileged communities through direct action and technology. We believe that with dedication, empathy, and transparent solutions, we can spark lasting, meaningful impact. Every hand extended in kindness brings us closer to a world where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

founder.bio: Charitize was founded to streamline charitable aid using modern web technology. By maintaining a lean, transparent operation, we ensure that resources go straight to communities in need without unnecessary overhead.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to uplift underprivileged communities by providing nutritious food, educational resources, and clean water access through transparent, community-centered initiatives.
points: Nutritious food assistance so no family goes to bed hungry.
Educational supplies and school kits for underprivileged youths.

donationCallout.text: Every contribution fuels immediate aid, warm meals, and school essentials for families in need.
